# TallyBook

> TallyBook is free, offline, keyboard-first desktop accounting software for Indian small businesses, made by Techardent Labs (Techardent Internet Pvt. Ltd.). It runs natively on Windows 10/11, macOS 11+ (Apple chip and Intel) and Linux, and follows the TallyPrime keyboard workflow (Gateway menu, F4–F9 vouchers, Alt+G Go To). It is not affiliated with Tally Solutions.

Key facts:
- Price: free; no licence fee and no yearly renewal.
- Data: stored only on the user's computer, one data file per company; backup and restore built in; optional TallyVault password encrypts a company's data and backups (a lost TallyVault password cannot be recovered).
- Features: GST invoices (CGST/SGST/IGST), GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-2B reconciliation, HSN summary, e-invoice and e-way bill JSON for offline upload; inventory with godowns, batches in vouchers, price levels, order tracking and FIFO/LIFO/average/standard costing; manufacturing with bill of materials and Manufacturing Journal; multiple companies (F3, Alt+F3, Ctrl+F3); payroll with PF (₹25,000 EPF wage ceiling from 17 September 2026), ESI, professional tax, salary income tax by slab (new or old regime) and gratuity; TDS/TCS with Income-tax Act 2025 sections from 1 April 2026; bill due dates, voucher classes, foreign-currency entry; bank reconciliation, cheque register and printing; cost centres, budgets and interest calculation; Balance Sheet, P&L, Trial Balance, Day Book, registers, cash flow, funds flow, ratios; users, roles and passwords; import from Tally XML and Excel/CSV.
- Limitations (version 0.2): single user per computer (no network multi-user), one company open at a time and no group companies, installers not yet code-signed, GST returns and e-invoice/e-way bill JSON are prepared for upload on the portals rather than filed or generated from the app, no connected banking, no job work yet, no batches or alternate units on manufacturing lines, no statutory return files (PF ECR, e-TDS/FVU).
- Updates: automatic in-app updates; monthly feature releases; statutory fixes released as needed.
